name: FlowMatchEulerDiscrete wrapper (diffusers)
plain: Exposes diffusers' FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler config as a node and registers scheduler names. Math is inside the diffusers library, which this pack calls; not read here. Pack's vq_diffusion handler returns a plain linear ramp.
math:
flow_match handler: diffusers scheduler.set_timesteps(steps, mu=…).sigmas (library code, not read).
vq_diffusion handler: σ=linspace(1,0,steps+1).

label: from code
